subject: Sales: Subprocessor landscape & compliance next steps
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & concrete next steps (subprocessors + SOC 2 / HIPAA)

Hi Emma — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call summary (highlight):
- Primary use case: HealthSync wants to embed Redwood-hosted inference for clinical triage summaries (low-latency, redaction controls).
- Data types: PHI + user-provided notes; HIPAA concerns surfaced.
- Current compliance state: you mentioned SOC 2 in progress and a legal review for BAAs.

Open asks we discussed (please confirm):
1) Subprocessor roster (cloud infra + any vendor-side ML ops): we need a simple CSV with vendor name, country of processing, data categories processed, and point of contact.
2) SOC 2 status: report scope (Type I vs II), expected completion date, and whether any outsourced sub-services are in-scope.
3) HIPAA / BAA: whether HealthSync can sign a BAA as-is or if legal needs a draft.
4) Any restrictions on outbound data sharing or storage duration (retention limits).

Proposed timeline / next steps:
- Emma: send subprocessor CSV + answers to (2)-(4) by EOD 2026-08-05 (or let us know ETA).
- Marissa (copied): if you can kick off our standard security questionnaire when we have the roster, we’ll route the most important items first (cloud providers, KMS/HSM usage, logging).
- Ben: I’ll loop you on commercial items once we have a better sense of retention and BAA timing.

Attachments referenced: we asked for a simple subprocessor export (CSV) and any SOC 2 summaries. If you can drop them in the shared Drive link below that’s ideal.

Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHealthSync-Redwood-MAP

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally after we get the CSV.

— Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0124

From: Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@healthsync.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthSync Security <security@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & concrete next steps (subprocessors + SOC 2 / HIPAA)

Hi Aisha — great to meet you and team. Thanks for the tidy recap. Quick responses below and I'm attaching the partial roster.

1) Subprocessor roster: attached is our export (healthsync-subprocessor-csv.csv). It includes our infra providers and a handful of managed services. Note: two smaller vendors are in procurement and not yet live.
2) SOC 2: we completed SOC 2 Type I (security) in 2025; Type II testing is underway — expected completion Q4 2026. Official report pending.
3) HIPAA / BAA: our legal team can sign a BAA; they asked us to share Redwood's standard BAA template or a draft contract clause for their counsel to review.
4) Retention: default clinical notes retention is 7 years, but we can scope per-project retention if needed.

Next steps from our side: we will drop the CSV in Drive and introduce our security lead (security@healthsync.com) to Marissa for the questionnaire. I’m available for a short follow-up on Friday if helpful.

Best,
Emma
Emma Bryant
Director of Product, HealthSync
emma.bryant@healthsync.com

Attachment: healthsync-subprocessor-csv.csv (1 file, 5KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & concrete next steps (kick off security questionnaire)

Thanks Aisha / Emma (copied). I’ll own the technical questionnaire and triage the roster. Initial plan:

- I’ll intake the CSV and map the top three cloud providers (infra + DB + logging) to our risk buckets.
- Priority asks for HealthSync to complete first: KMS/HSM usage, data-at-rest encryption, VPC peering details, retention enforcement controls, and whether any vendor holds raw PHI outside the EU/US.
- Attach: Redwood_Security_SQ_v2.pdf — this is our condensed vendor SQ we use for fast-tracking proof-of-controls. Please fill the red sections first (cloud infra + DB).

Can someone at HealthSync (security@healthsync.com) take the SQ and return within 5 business days? If not possible, propose a narrower scope (cloud infra + logs) and we’ll accept that initially.

Aisha — please add the Drive link to the SQ and set permissions for security@healthsync.com. Ben — I may need a brief intro to commercial on any retention exceptions that would affect pricing.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T16:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & concrete next steps (commercial alignment)

Perfect — thanks Aisha. Two quick commercial notes I’ll handle:
1) I’ll reserve an internal slot for legal to review a BAA; can you (or HealthSync) share the draft BAA link so I can get counsel involved?
2) Retention adjustments + additional logging retention will likely move this into a slightly higher tier; I’ll prep a simple delta estimate once Marissa confirms the required retention windows and whether logging falls under the same SLA.

Propose we lock a follow-up working session next Tue 8/11 to review the SQ responses and any SOC 2 evidence. If HealthSync can return the SQ earlier, we’ll accelerate.

— Ben
